passages.title: 야유회 날짜 투표 메일
passages.passage:
From: HR Team
To: All Staff
Subject: Vote for the Picnic Date

Hello everyone,

Our spring company picnic will be at Maple Lake Park. Two dates are possible: Friday, May 16, or Friday, May 23.

Please vote for your preferred date on the intranet by this Thursday. The date with more votes wins, and we will announce it Friday morning. Lunch and games are on the company!

HR Team

questions.q: What are staff asked to do?
questions.exKo: 야유회 날짜 두 가지 중 하나에 투표해 달라는 요청입니다.
why: 공원 예약은 이미 회사가 정해 둠
게임 준비가 아니라 날짜 투표를 요청함
questions.ev: Please vote for your preferred date on the intranet by this Thursday.

questions.q: Where will the picnic be held?
questions.exKo: will be at Maple Lake Park라고 명시합니다.
why: 야유회 장소가 Maple Lake Park라고 명시
City Hall Park라는 장소는 지문에 없음
questions.ev: Our spring company picnic will be at Maple Lake Park.

questions.q: When will the date be announced?
questions.exKo: we will announce it Friday morning에서 확인됩니다.
why: 금요일 오전에 확정 날짜를 발표한다고 명시
목요일은 투표 마감 시한(단어 반복 함정)
questions.ev: The date with more votes wins, and we will announce it Friday morning.

passages.title: 결제 카드 만료 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: StreamBox
To: Aaron Miles
Subject: Update Your Payment Card

Dear Mr. Miles,

The credit card on your StreamBox account expires at the end of this month. To keep watching without a break, please update your card details in Settings before June 30.

If the card is not updated, your account will be paused — your watch list and settings will be saved for 90 days.

StreamBox Support

questions.q: Why was the email sent?
choices: A payment card is about to expire
questions.exKo: 등록된 카드가 이달 말 만료되어 갱신을 요청하는 메일입니다.
why: 카드 만료 임박을 알리고 갱신을 요청하는 메일
questions.ev: The credit card on your StreamBox account expires at the end of this month.

questions.q: What happens if the card is not updated?
questions.exKo: your account will be paused라고 안내합니다.
why: 카드 미갱신 시 계정이 일시 정지된다고 명시
삭제가 아니라 일시 정지이며 정보는 보관됨
추가 요금 부과는 지문에 언급 없음
아무 변화 없다는 것은 지문과 반대
questions.ev: If the card is not updated, your account will be paused

questions.q: How long will settings be saved?
questions.exKo: saved for 90 days에서 확인됩니다.
questions.ev: your watch list and settings will be saved for 90 days

passages.title: 로비 리모델링 공사 공지
passages.passage:
LOBBY RENOVATION

The main lobby will be renovated from July 7 to July 25. During this time, please enter the building through the east door, next to the cafe.

The front desk will move to the east hallway. Deliveries will also be received there. The new lobby will have more seating and a digital directory. We appreciate your patience.

Building Management

questions.q: What is happening from July 7 to 25?
choices: The east door is being repaired
A new desk is being built
questions.exKo: 로비 리모델링 공사 기간과 이용 안내를 담은 공지입니다.

questions.q: How should people enter the building?
questions.exKo: enter the building through the east door라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What will the new lobby have?
choices: More seating and a digital directory
questions.exKo: more seating and a digital directory에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 명절 배송 마감 공지
passages.passage:
HOLIDAY SHIPPING DEADLINES

To receive packages before the holiday, please note our shipping deadlines: standard shipping orders by December 15, express orders by December 20.

Orders placed after these dates will arrive after the holiday. Our customer center closes December 24 and 25 and reopens December 26 with normal hours.

Giftly Shipping Team

questions.q: What is the notice about?
questions.exKo: 명절 전 배송을 위한 주문 마감일 안내입니다.

questions.q: By when should express orders be placed?
questions.exKo: express orders by December 20라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: When does the customer center reopen?
questions.exKo: reopens December 26 with normal hours에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 공유 오피스 첫 달 할인 광고
passages.passage:
WORKNEST — YOUR DESK IS WAITING

Tired of noisy cafes? WorkNest offers quiet desks, fast internet, and free meeting rooms in the heart of downtown.

Plans start at $99 a month, and your first month is half price. Members get 24-hour access and free coffee. Book a free day pass on our website and try us out this week!

questions.q: What is WorkNest?
questions.exKo: 도심의 공유 오피스를 홍보하는 광고입니다.

questions.q: What discount do new members get?
choices: Half price for the first month
questions.exKo: your first month is half price라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: How can people try WorkNest?
choices: Book a free day pass online
questions.exKo: Book a free day pass on our website에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 어학원 점심시간 회화반 광고
passages.passage:
LUNCHTIME ENGLISH AT TALK POINT ACADEMY

Too busy for evening classes? Join our 40-minute lunchtime conversation classes, made for office workers.

Classes meet Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 12:10, right next to Central Plaza. Groups are small — six students at most. The first class is free. Monthly fee: $80. Bring your lunch; coffee is on us!

questions.q: Who are the classes designed for?
questions.exKo: 직장인을 위한 점심시간 영어 회화반 광고입니다.

questions.q: How large are the classes?
questions.exKo: six students at most라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What does the academy provide?
questions.exKo: Bring your lunch; coffee is on us에서 커피를 제공함을 알 수 있습니다.

passages.title: 구시가지 벽화 거리 기사
passages.passage:
OLDPORT — Ten empty walls in the old market district now display large murals painted by local artists. The city paid for paint, and shop owners offered their walls.

Since the murals appeared, weekend visitors to the district have increased by about 30 percent, according to the merchants association. Guided mural walks start next month, leaving from the clock tower every Saturday at 2 p.m.

questions.q: What is the article about?
choices: Murals bringing visitors to a district
questions.exKo: 구시가지 벽화가 방문객을 늘리고 있다는 기사입니다.

questions.q: How much did weekend visitors increase?
questions.exKo: increased by about 30 percent라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What starts next month?
questions.exKo: Guided mural walks start next month에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 중소기업 4일 근무 실험 기사
passages.passage:
GRANTON — Design firm Blue Arrow has tested a four-day workweek for six months. Employees work Monday through Thursday, with the same pay as before.

The firm says projects were finished on time and sick days dropped by half. Customers noticed no difference in service. Blue Arrow will keep the schedule for another year and share results with other local businesses.

questions.q: What did Blue Arrow test?
questions.exKo: 디자인 회사의 주 4일 근무 실험에 관한 기사입니다.

questions.q: What happened to sick days?
questions.exKo: sick days dropped by half라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What will the firm do next?
choices: Keep the schedule for another year
questions.exKo: keep the schedule for another year에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 택시 합승 제안 문자
passages.passage:
Fiona Cole (6:05 P.M.)
Hey Raj, are you going to the airport conference hotel tomorrow morning?

Raj Mehta (6:07 P.M.)
Yes, my flight briefing is at 10.

Fiona Cole (6:08 P.M.)
Want to share a taxi? We could split the $40 fare.

Raj Mehta (6:09 P.M.)
Good idea. Pick me up at my apartment at 8? It's on the way.

Fiona Cole (6:10 P.M.)
Perfect. I'll book the taxi for 7:50 and text you when we're close.

questions.q: What does Ms. Cole suggest?
questions.exKo: 택시를 같이 타고 요금을 나누자고 제안합니다.

questions.q: How much is the full fare?
questions.exKo: split the $40 fare에서 확인됩니다.

questions.q: What will Ms. Cole do?
choices: Book the taxi and text when close
questions.exKo: I'll book the taxi for 7:50 and text you when we're close라고 말합니다.

passages.title: 사무실 열쇠 전달 문자
passages.passage:
Martin Hale (7:45 A.M.)
Morning, Judy. I'm at the office but my key card is at home. Are you nearby?

Judy Chen (7:47 A.M.)
I'm 10 minutes away. Hang on!

Martin Hale (7:48 A.M.)
Thanks. The cleaning crew let me into the lobby, but our floor is locked.

Judy Chen (7:49 A.M.)
No worries. By the way, security can issue a one-day pass at the desk — for next time!

Martin Hale (7:50 A.M.)
Good to know. Coffee's on me today.

questions.q: What is Mr. Hale's problem?
choices: He left his key card at home
questions.exKo: 카드 키를 집에 두고 와서 사무실 층에 들어가지 못하고 있습니다.

questions.q: Who let Mr. Hale into the lobby?
questions.exKo: The cleaning crew let me into the lobby에서 확인됩니다.

questions.q: What does Ms. Chen suggest for next time?
choices: Getting a one-day pass from security
questions.exKo: security can issue a one-day pass at the desk라고 알려 줍니다.
